{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45). Nobody spoke while I was there, so I have no new evidence on any individual. Nothing here should change ratings.

Table state: every domino is dark, so the whole build is connected to the start. The bottom line is clean and smooth. The top line is still doubled or overlapping from about x=9 to x=19-20, with no visible fix. It is connected, so it should fall, but the overlap is still a possible misfire at the push. The tail ends are open (top ends near x=27.5,y=3.5; bottom near x=27.5,y=16.5). That is fine for toppling. Still no hand labels, so I can't say who placed what and won't score on attribution.

Tom: Silent. Last visit he said he'd keep his hands off and shout if anything tips. I have still never seen him place anything. Impact and execution unverified. Ask him directly what he built.

Maya: Silent. Earlier she handed over the fork and acted as quality checker. Leadership and collaboration look strongest. Execution unverified. She hasn't flagged the overlap that I know of.

Priya: Silent. Earlier she checked connectivity and offered help closing gaps. Collaborative. Ask her privately about the overlap and the role changes.

Leo: Silent. He said he'd check the doubled back, and it is still doubled. Good intent, no visible result.

Next: watch the push, since that tests whether the overlap misfires. Then ask each person privately who built what and who knew about the doubling. Hold ratings until then. Provisional view: Maya leadership and collaboration strong, Priya collaboration good, Tom and Leo impact and execution unclear."}
